svg.title: Tournaments — scheduled Swiss events with live reserved games
svg.desc: TournamentService answers player commands; TournamentRuntimeService runs the clock-driven lifecycle (pair rounds, create reserved rooms, check-ins, no-shows) and receives each finished pairing from GameCompletionService through TournamentCompletionSink.
svg.text: Tournaments — scheduled Swiss events with live reserved games
TournamentService answers player commands; TournamentRuntimeService runs the clock-driven lifecycle (pair rounds, create reserved
rooms, check-ins, no-shows) and receives each finished pairing from GameCompletionService through TournamentCompletionSink.
+ create_tournament(ctx, actor, name, rounds, base, inc, ...) : void
+ join_tournament(ctx, actor, elo, tournament_id, sink) : void
+ check_in_round(ctx, actor, tournament_id, round, sink) : void
+ check_in_and_bind(tid, round, actor, fd, gen) : TournamentCheckInResult
Each round: pair (Swiss: equal scores, avoid rematches,
balance colours) -> reserved rooms -> check-in window ->
<<interface>> = abstract class with only pure virtual methods; <<abstract>> = has some.
